sources.name: role_assignment_name
sources.note: It lists the role assignments (access grants) for the subscription, which a general resource inventory doesn't return.

sources.name: name
sources.note: This is the general ARM resource inventory, and it is read once per resource group because it needs at least one of name, resource_group_name or type.

Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments.note: Role assignments are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Compute/disks.note: Managed disks are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSet.note: Linux is the most common VMSS flavor, and it is imported by its full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries.note: Container registries are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.ContainerService/managedCluste.note: AKS managed clusters are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults.note: Key vaults are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedId.note: User-assigned identities are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Network/dnszones.note: DNS zones are imported by ARM ID, but the provider requires the segment to be spelled `dnsZones`, so the lowercase `dnszones` is rewritten.

Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers.note: Load balancers are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups.note: Network security groups are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Network/networkWatchers.note: Network watchers are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses.note: Public IP addresses are imported by their full ARM resource ID.

Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks.note: Virtual networks are imported by their full ARM resource ID.
